title: cerinthodes lanceolatum
intro: Cerinthodes lanceolatum, commonly known as the 'Lance-leaved cerinthe', is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and alleviating symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cerinthodes lanceolatum include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in wound healing and skin care applications. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, contributing to its therapeutic properties.
